name: actually-asked
description:
Actually Asked is a FAQ for websites and Shopify stores that grows from what visitors ask. Visitors ask their own question under the FAQ, or highlight a sentence and ask about it, and answers come only from the site's own pages, products, policies and files.

With this app, ChatGPT manages that FAQ in your Actually Asked account:

- See what visitors asked, what your pages couldn't answer, and the visitors waiting for a reply.
- Review suggested FAQ entries, check each answer against your pages, fix the wording and publish them.
- Add, edit, pin, group and remove FAQ entries, and choose which pages each group shows on.
- Search everything Actually Asked has read on your site, so answers are written from your pages rather than general knowledge.
- Change what the FAQ section says and how it looks, get the install snippet for your platform, and check that it's live.

It keeps the dashboard's rules: entries you wrote are never rewritten by the system, removed questions stay removed, and it asks before deleting a group or page rule or discarding a question. It never sends email: you reply to visitors from your own inbox.

You need an Actually Asked account with your site added.
